title: Scenes using the same script breaks on preload with a global and circular typing - "referenced non-existent resource"
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3.stable, 4.4.beta3

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5186) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

When the main scene and a global respectively reference the scenes scene1 and scene2, which both use a shared script with a variable with the type of the main scene, you get the following error:

```
E 0:00:01:0495   _printerr: res://scene1.tscn:6 - Parse Error: [ext_resource] referenced non-existent resource at: res://shared.gd.
  <C++ Source>   scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:39 @ _printerr()
```

### Steps to reproduce

Create a main scene with a script containing this code:

```
class_name MainNode
extends Node2D
var scene1: Shared = preload("res://scene1.tscn").instantiate()
```

Create a global with this code:

```
extends Node
var scene2 = preload("res://scene2.tscn").instantiate()
```

Create scene1 and scene2 with a shared script containing this code:

```
class_name Shared
extends Node2D
var main: MainNode
```

When you run this, it throws the following error:

```
E 0:00:01:0495   _printerr: res://scene1.tscn:6 - Parse Error: [ext_resource] referenced non-existent resource at: res://shared.gd.
  <C++ Source>   scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:39 @ _printerr()
```

And then crashes with this error on the `var scene1...` line:

```
Trying to assign value of type `Node2D` to a variable of type `shared.gd`
```

If I remove the `Shared` class-name and typing, it still throws the first error and it then crashes when trying to access any variable or function on `scene1`, saying those are nonexistent.

Any of the following works:

- Using `load` instead of `preload` in the main scene
- Putting both `preloads` in the main scene
- Removing the `MainNode` typing

There are enough workarounds, but it seems like this should work, and it's quite the cryptic error to figure out.

I saw the [cyclic dependency tracker](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/80877). But I didn't see much about getting an error caused merely by adding typing, without any actual cyclic loads.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18796765/project.zip)
